item.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has said he is disappointed in his team’s 3-0 defeat to Brighton and Hove Albion at the AMEX in the Premier League on Saturday. The Gunners’ 100 per cent start to the new Premier League season came to an abrupt halt on Saturday afternoon, losing 3-0 at the AMEX Stadium.
